catalog.title: MEHLISSA Next model and starter-example catalog
catalog.description: Curated discovery metadata for the implemented model families and representative configurations. Catalog maturity is an evidence statement, not a clinical-readiness claim.

models.title: Systemic vascular transport
models.summary: A deterministic 95-segment vascular graph transports entities through the whole-body circulation and accepts versioned physiological-state overlays.
models.validity_scope: The accepted reference preserves the dissertation-era BVS/MEHLISSA graph, branching, flow, and timing semantics for reproducible research comparisons.
models.evidence_summary: Legacy inputs were migrated with author permission, schema-checked, and covered by invariant, transport, observation, and historical BVS regression tests.

parameters.meaning: Mean volumetric flow assigned to each vascular segment.
Probability of selecting a successor at a vascular branch.
Global flow multiplier applied by a compatible body-state overlay.

limitations: The vascular coordinates are a schematic historical geometry, not segmented anatomy.
The accepted reference does not model pulsatile pressure, autoregulation, disease, or patient-specific circulation.
Historical regression agreement does not establish physiological or clinical prediction validity.

models.title: Pulmonary zero-dimensional circulation
models.summary: Replaceable lung models range from one equivalent pulmonary bed to five parallel lobar beds with bounded flow, age, resistance, compliance, and distensibility variants.
models.validity_scope: Healthy-adult aggregate pulmonary hemodynamics at rest and bounded exercise; the current five-lobe reference preserves the qualified aggregate model while exposing regional routing.
models.evidence_summary: Parameters cite pulmonary literature; multiple independent aggregate endpoints and a separate perfusion distribution are checked, while regional and joint validation gaps remain explicit.

parameters.meaning: Reference pulmonary blood flow used by the model.
Aggregate pulmonary vascular resistance at the reference state.
Fraction of aggregate pulmonary flow assigned to a named lobe.
Default adult age for age-conditioned resistance selection.

limitations: The models are zero-dimensional or equivalent-bed representations rather than anatomical flow fields.
Five-lobe proportions are fixed and do not adapt to gravity, posture, disease, exercise, or recruitment.
No current lung model is a diagnostic, treatment, or patient-specific model.

models.title: Capillary transit, exchange, and molecular channels
models.summary: A replaceable capillary layer supports conserved transit, recruitment, exchange, entity observation and disposition, plus analytical, Brownian, trajectory, radial-field, and axial molecular channels.
models.validity_scope: The pulmonary card constrains equivalent geometry and transit; most molecular kinetics and tracer cases remain synthetic verification inputs.
models.evidence_summary: Continuity, amount balance, deterministic replay, analytical comparisons, convergence, and bounded work are tested; the pulmonary equivalent geometry is literature-qualified separately.

parameters.meaning: Axial length of the one-dimensional transport domain.
Equivalent lumen radius used for cross-section-averaged transport.
Molecular diffusion coefficient in the axial reference case.

limitations: The equivalent pulmonary capillary is not an anatomical alveolar-sheet reconstruction.
Current molecular diffusivity, reaction, and wall-interaction fixtures are not qualified biomarker kinetics.
Blood rheology, hematocrit, cellular obstruction, and spatial tissue coupling remain outside the accepted model.

models.title: Receptor binding and intracellular response
models.summary: Analytical, time-varying, and stochastic receptor binding feed a shared intracellular ODE/SSA network, conservative delivery, apoptosis commitment, feedback, and cohort-compressed populations.
models.validity_scope: Generic software contracts for composing binding, signaling, delivery, and response without silently violating amount ownership.
models.evidence_summary: Closed-form solutions, stochastic moments, ODE/SSA agreement, conservation, threshold events, scaling, and deterministic replay are verified with synthetic parameters.

parameters.meaning: Association-rate constant for one-to-one receptor-ligand binding.
Bound-receptor fraction that emits the synthetic detection event.

limitations: All current kinetic, concentration, threshold, delivery, and population values are synthetic software fixtures.
No named disease biomarker, cell type, drug, pharmacokinetics, toxicity, or treatment efficacy is validated.
The cell layer must not be used to infer biological or clinical sensitivity, specificity, or response.

models.title: Nano-IoT communication and governed station loop
models.summary: Typed nanodevices, local links, relays, an active gateway, body-area-network transport, an external station, and an optional network-simulator boundary preserve causal identity and separate communication metrics.
models.validity_scope: Deterministic interface, routing, accounting, failure, and governance contracts for an end-to-end research demonstrator.
models.evidence_summary: Positive workflows and twelve fail-closed loss, corruption, expiry, replay, policy, identity, and capacity cases verify the implemented software boundaries.

parameters.meaning: Prescribed one-hop delivery latency for the synthetic link.
Communication energy charged for each attempted transmission.
Maximum number of links allowed in a selected local route.

limitations: Latency, energy, delivery outcomes, capacities, and topologies are synthetic verification values.
No calibrated radio, molecular-communication, interference, queueing, or hardware behavior is claimed.
No authentication, encryption, clinical authorization, cybersecurity guarantee, or treatment-safety claim is implemented.
